Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldBuilder.TextBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldBuilder.TextBuilder
Enclosing class:
SldBuilder
public static final class SldBuilder.TextBuilder extends Object
Full-featured builder for a <TextSymbolizer>.

Controls every aspect of label rendering:

  • Label content — feature attribute (SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.label(String)), OGC expression (SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.label(SldExpression)), or static text (SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.staticLabel(String))
  • Font — family (font(String, double) / fontFamilies(java.lang.String...)), weight (bold()), style (italic(), oblique())
  • Halo — outline around the text for readability (halo(String, double))
  • Placement — point with anchor and displacement (pointPlacement(double, double)) or following the line geometry (linePlacement(double))
  • GeoServer vendor options — labelling behaviour tuning via vendorOption(String, String)

Call end() to finalize the symbolizer and return to the parent SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.

Since:
1.0.0
